scope: Same production Reanimation API, authored tracks, RootMotion and GetFrameTime consumers. Forward loops only. Same bench-validate.obj linked for all three executables, MSVC O2/GL/LTCG, process pinned LP14. No frequency lock performed or verified.
methods: while_cached: keyframe-local epoch and frame cache, genuine while(age>=framePeriod){age-=framePeriod;++frame;wrap}; snapshot queries reuse state
divide_update_cached_queries: cycle-local epoch, quotient/remainder each update, snapshot queries reuse derived frame
divide_every_query: cycle-local epoch, frame calculation deferred to each query
timing: Same timestamp sequences; 1 million updates/round, 5 rounds per executable order, forward then reverse order; ten samples per cell, median ns/operation.
validation: 1440 rows /48 cells have identical checksums across variants and both orders. All three execute exact integer phase, loop count, per-update crossings, previous event phase, authored frame/root output validation before timing.
disassembly: Measured while executable hot forward block 0x140231BCD..0x140231D7D contains zero integer DIV/IDIV instructions and a backward conditional branch at0x140231C70 to0x140231C50. Full Reanimation fallback for unsupported cases remains outside the measured path. Floating-point interpolation division is common to consumers.
limitations: Not whole-game/render timing; candidate implementations deliberately cover forward loops only, not reverse, rate/seek transitions, endpoint/hold or save semantics. No production code replaced.
